profile.headline: Principal Engineer at Metaswitch Networks
profile.summary:
Experienced professional software engineer developing object-oriented applications in the areas of Operating Systems, Middleware, Call Processing, Audio/Video technologies, and optical switching.  Work experience has been in areas of systems engineering, requirements gathering, system architecture, high-level design, low-level design, implementation, testing, and system testing with little or no supervision.   Proven problem solver.  Excellent object-oriented design skills.  Broad breadth of knowledge and experience and can quickly become productive.  Usually in a lead engineering role directing and mentoring other engineers.

Specialties: Operating Systems, Middleware, Audio/Video development on Windows and Mac.

positions.title: Contractor Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for developing support for the IGMP protocol using the latest Broadcom Sand architecture.  Requires detailed familiarity with the Qumran Filter Processing for multicast for both ethernet and GPON interfaces using layer 2 forwarding and packet trapping.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Technical position in the development of a regression test suite for a complete VoLTE system using Ruby scripting.  The script simulated a UE and tested SIP signaling for various features such as registration, IPSec, IPv6, Sip Digest, AKA, basic call flows, extended call flows, number portability, ENUM, SNMP, preconditions,  IR.92 MMTel, IR.94 video conferencing, eSRVCC, and ATGW transcoding.  Developed the capability of sending actual media streams using various codecs such as AMR-WB, AMR, VP8 and H.264.  Developed an MSC simulator for eSRVCC handoffs.  Modified the OpenIMS HSS to support the extended Sh interface for eSRVCC.    Used the regression suite to test the entire system in absence of a reliable VoLTE handset.  
Developed test plans for the system test of features, developed automated test suites, and manually tested different features.  Developed Functional Specifications for various features.  This required an extensive knowledge of 3GPP specifications, RFCs, GSMA specifications, ITU specifications, ETSI, IEC, ANSI, IEEE and third-party documents.  Part of the testing required familiarity with setting up OpenStack and VMWare virtual machines and IP networking.  The position required familiarity with SIP, audio and video media, RTP, SDP, Diameter, XCAP, HTTP, and SQL.
Technical position in the development of the Metaswitch LFA product whose purpose was to extend the life of the Nortel DMS-100 with modern controllers and a GR-303 interface to the CFS.  I developed the CLI, call processing fault recovery, line card control, line test features, and line reflectometry testing.  Development was in C++ for the VxWorks OS.  Experience with interfacing to the board FPGA and ASIC.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description: Lead technical position in the development of a C++ based SDK which supports video conferencing over the internet, encoded audio/video file creation, and encoded audio/video rendering.  The position requires expertise in C++ development, Microsoft Visual Studio, DirectShow, DirectX, COM, various audio/video codec technologies, RTP, H.323, H.264, tunneling, and multicast protocols.  Also requires experience in Mac OSX C++, Objective-C, Java , XCode development utilizing Apple's video and audio technologies, iOS, Cocoa, Core Audio, Core Video, QuickTime, QTKit, RTP, SIP, RTSP.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description: Led a team of 4 American engineers in the development of the DPE Middleware for the Mendel platform.  The Mendel platform is used on Samsung's WCDMA, Softswitch, and IMS products.  Developed a scalable implementation for the MGCP, Megaco, and SIP protocols for Samsung's Softswitch product.  Provided Systems Engineering for the IP architecture for Samsung's Softswitch project, IPV4/IPV6 imteroperability, IPSec, and the high-level design for an IPV4/IPV6 interoperable framework.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead 5 engineers in the development of the British Telecom NetMaster project involving automatic fault detection and resolution of local exchange to customer premises.  Lead 5 engineers in AIN development activities using object-oriented methodologies.  Participated in the development of services for BT's application.  Developed the Configuration Management for software control using Clearcase and Multisite.  Worked with British engineers in the development of AIN services.

positions.title: Technical Leader
positions.description: Technical leader of nine engineers for the development of the Switch Control Processor for the GTE Airfone project.  Trained the engineers in OO methodology, developed the overall architecture for the system, the documentation standards, the inspection criteria, and presented the architecture and detailed design to the customer.  Developed detailed schedules for the project, providing technical consultation for members of the team, and personally developed the system configuration and recovery area.

positions.title: Technical Leader
positions.description:
Technical leader of seven engineers for the development of an execution environment on an AIN platform.  This was an object-oriented project using C++.  The areas of responsibility were Service Logic and Control, Data Collection, and the Craft/SMS/SEAS support.

Technical Leader and Architect (9/84-5/90)
Technical lead and architect in the development of a port of the DSC embedded operating system to a Motorola 68030 processor based board.  This required the development of a modern program model, extensive use of the MMU to provide program protection, and the development of support tools which required little or no changes to existing application programs.  Both C and 68030 assembly language were used.  Development was on an Apollo workstation using UNIX BSD 4.3.
•	Technical lead in the kernel area of the operating system responsible for both maintenance and development.
•	Directed the activities of 5 engineers.
•	As an individual contributor, participated in OS development for DSC’s cross connect products.  In addition, developed firmware for all of DSC’s processor boards (9/84-2/91).

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: Contractor at DSC Communications, MCI, Sprint, and U.S. Tel.  Involved in assembly language firmware development, assembly language telephony development on the Danray 4K and 1K switches (principally in call history collection), and worked on a switch activity reporting system (FORTRAN and COBOL).

positions.title: Telecommunications Engineer/Production Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software for Sun's fuel bulk loading dispensing and billing system.
Wrote requirements specifications for software and hardware products to be used by Sun Oil Company in the Telecommunications and SCADA areas.
Worked as Junior Production engineer.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
